Title: MeNetModel: A cross-platform engine for enzyme-constrained metabolic modeling and enzyme resource prioritization
Summary: Presents MeNetModel, a cross-platform engine for enzyme-constrained metabolic modeling (ecModels) that extends flux balance analysis with enzyme catalytic and protein allocation constraints for enzyme resource prioritization.

Title: Light-dependent metabolism and proteome allocation in Synechocystis sp. PCC 6803: an enzyme-constrained metabolic model across light intensities
Summary: Constructs an enzyme-constrained genome-scale metabolic model of Synechocystis sp. PCC 6803 to study light-dependent metabolism and proteome allocation across light intensities.

Title: A benchmarking framework for single-cell genome-scale metabolic model construction
Summary: Introduces a benchmarking framework for constructing single-cell genome-scale metabolic models (scGEMs) used to characterize metabolic heterogeneity across cellular states.

Title: Enzyme kinetics shapes the growth response of metabolic networks
Summary: Establishes a metabolic model that integrates local enzyme kinetics and global network architecture to explain how enzyme kinetics shape microbial growth responses.

Title: The Evolution of Standards in Systems Biology: from Metabolic and Multi-Scale to Whole-Cell Models
Summary: Reviews the evolution of standards, formats, and tool ecosystems for mechanistic systems biology models, from metabolic and multi-scale models to whole-cell models.

Title: Machine learning for mechanistic modeling of plant metabolic pathways
Summary: Reviews machine learning approaches for mechanistic modeling of plant metabolic pathways, including examples from non-plant metabolic modeling.

Title: Integrating Machine Learning and Transcriptomics to Enhance β-Carotene Production in Saccharomyces cerevisiae
Summary: Combines transcriptomic sequencing and machine learning to guide β-carotene production in Saccharomyces cerevisiae.

Title: ESM2-Guided Context-Aware Annotation Completion Supplements Carbohydrate Metabolism Coverage in Silage Microbial Metagenomes
Summary: Uses the ESM2 protein language model for context-aware annotation completion, recovering enzyme-level carbohydrate metabolism coverage in silage microbial metagenomes.

Title: Expanding the catabolic capacity of Pseudomonas putida to acetovanillone, 5-carboxyvanillate, and vanillyl glyoxylate for muconate production from kraft lignin-derived aromatics
Summary: Expands Pseudomonas putida catabolism of kraft lignin-derived aromatics (acetovanillone, 5-carboxyvanillate, and vanillyl glyoxylate) for muconate production.

Title: Metabolic Engineering of Yarrowia lipolytica for High-Level de novo Biosynthesis of Xylitol from Glucose
Summary: Engineers Yarrowia lipolytica as a cell factory by constructing a core biosynthetic route for high-level de novo xylitol production from glucose.

Title: Carbon source–driven metabolic and regulatory remodeling defines phenomic states in Lipomyces starkeyi
Summary: Defines carbon source–driven metabolic and regulatory phenomic states in Lipomyces starkeyi, providing a reference for strain engineering under distinct carbon constraints.

Title: Biosynthesis of isoprene glycol from glucose by metabolically engineered Escherichia coli
Summary: Engineers Escherichia coli to produce isoprene glycol de novo from glucose by converting acetyl-CoA to the non-natural metabolite HMB-CoA and applying two reduction strategies.

Title: Adaptive laboratory evolution rewires Pseudomonas putida for resource-efficient acetate assimilation
Summary: Uses adaptive laboratory evolution, reverse engineering, and multi-omics including 13C fluxomics to rewire Pseudomonas putida for acetate-tolerant, resource-efficient acetate assimilation.

Title: Metabolic engineering of Pseudomonas sp. NGC7 for glucose-free 4-hydroxybenzoic acid production
Summary: Metabolically engineers Pseudomonas sp. NGC7 to produce 4-hydroxybenzoic acid from sugarcane-bagasse aromatics without using glucose as a carbon source.

Title: Decoding Tumour-Specific Rewiring and Synthetic Lethality Through Genome-Scale Metabolic Models
Summary: Builds context-specific genome-scale metabolic models for eight tumour types from TCGA expression data and uses constraint-based modelling to map tissue-specific rewiring and synthetic lethality.

Title: Combining adaptive laboratory evolution and metabolic engineering for efficient erythritol production from crude glycerol by Yarrowia lipolytica
Summary: Combines adaptive laboratory evolution under hyperosmotic stress with metabolic engineering of Yarrowia lipolytica for efficient erythritol production from crude glycerol.

Title: Hybrid mechanistic-machine learning models in biosciences: Causality, forecasting, and lab-to-field translation
Summary: Reviews hybrid mechanistic–machine learning models that combine known mechanisms such as stoichiometry and conservation laws with data-driven terms for causality, forecasting, and lab-to-field translation.

Title: Engineering Kluyveromyces marxianus for efficient 2-phenylethanol production: From metabolic design to process innovation
Summary: Reviews metabolic engineering and process strategies for 2-phenylethanol production in Kluyveromyces marxianus, including central carbon metabolism and the Ehrlich pathway.

Title: GAMclust: identification of regulated metabolic modules in bulk, single cell and spatial gene expression data
Summary: Presents GAMclust, an R package that identifies transcriptionally regulated metabolic modules from bulk, single-cell, and spatial gene-expression data using genome-scale metabolic networks.

Title: Metabolic Engineering of Pseudomonas putida KT2440 for β-Nicotinamide Mononucleotide Biosynthesis from Glucose and Aspartate
Summary: Engineers Pseudomonas putida KT2440 for NMN biosynthesis from glucose and aspartate using a block–enhance–transport strategy that blocks nicotinic acid degradation and boosts the NMN pathway.

Title: Metabolic rewiring of nitrogen assimilation by low-cost monosodium glutamate enhances carbon capture and biomass production in Cyanobacterium aponinum PCC10605
Summary: Rewires nitrogen assimilation in Cyanobacterium aponinum PCC10605 with low-cost monosodium glutamate to enhance carbon capture and biomass production.

Title: Genome-scale metabolic model atlas of the zoonotic pathogen Streptococcus suis
Summary: Constructs an atlas of over 3000 strain-specific genome-scale metabolic models of Streptococcus suis covering pathogenic and commensal lineages.

Title: Next-Generation Metabolic Models: From Multi-Constraint Integration to AI-Driven Whole-Cell Kinetic Simulation
Summary: Reviews next-generation metabolic models from multi-constraint integration to AI-driven whole-cell kinetic simulation, including flux balance analysis and metabolic pathway analysis.

Title: DigiPhen: a new paradigm for building predictive models of biological systems
Summary: Presents DigiPhen, a digital phenome platform that combines experimental, analytical, and modeling workflows to build multi-scale predictive models of microbial and plant phenotypes.

Title: PEtab SciML: an exchange format for specifying and training dynamic scientific machine learning models
Summary: Introduces PEtab SciML, an exchange format and tooling for specifying and jointly training mechanistic ODE and machine-learning components in dynamic scientific machine-learning models.

Title: A Structural Theory of Admissible Transitions in Biological Reaction Networks
Summary: Introduces admissible transitions, a kinetics-independent structural criterion for feasible changes between species configurations in biological reaction networks.

Title: Application and progress of synthetic biology technology in amino acid production
Summary: Reviews synthetic biology strategies for amino acid production, covering metabolic pathway design, genetic circuits, dynamic regulation, and high-throughput screening.

Title: Metabolic engineering of Rhodococcus aromaticivorans RHA1 for muconic acid production from lignin
Summary: Engineers Rhodococcus aromaticivorans RHA1 to convert kraft lignin-derived aromatics (vanillin, vanillate, and acetovanillone) to muconic acid at 97% molar yield.

Title: Improving acetate metabolism of P. putida KT2440 by evolutionary and rational engineering
Summary: Combines rational overexpression of acetyl-CoA synthetase with adaptive laboratory evolution to improve Pseudomonas putida KT2440 growth and HAA production on acetate.

Title: Engineering Escherichia coli to modulate hydrogen sulfide levels using insights from intestinal sulfur metabolism
Summary: Engineers Escherichia coli strains to produce or consume hydrogen sulfide in specific intestinal regions by incorporating local metabolic environment into the design.

Title: Engineering Synthetic Membraneless Organelles Towards Efficient Hydrogen Production in Escherichia coli
Summary: Engineers synthetic membraneless organelles in Escherichia coli to compartmentalize hydrogenase activity toward more efficient hydrogen production.

Title: Engineering Microbial Consortia for Coordinated Control of Metabolic Roles and Electron Flows in Dark-Fermentative Hydrogen Production
Summary: Reviews microbial consortium engineering to coordinate metabolic roles and electron flows for more selective and stable dark-fermentative hydrogen production.
